question: 氵
answer: Water — left-side form of 水 (shuǐ). Found in characters related to water, liquids, rivers.
explanation: 河 (hé river), 海 (hǎi sea), 泳 (yǒng swim) — all contain 氵meaning water.

question: 口
answer: Mouth. Found in characters related to speaking, eating, openings.
explanation: 吃 (chī eat), 喝 (hē drink), 说 (shuō speak) — all contain 口 mouth.

question: 人 / 亻
answer: Person. 亻is the left-side form. Found in characters about people and human actions.
explanation: 他 (tā he), 你 (nǐ you), 们 (men plural marker) — all contain 亻person radical.

question: 木
answer: Tree / Wood. Found in characters related to trees, wood, furniture.
explanation: 树 (shù tree), 桌 (zhuō table), 椅 (yǐ chair) — all contain 木 wood.

question: 日
answer: Sun / Day. Found in characters related to the sun, time, brightness.
explanation: 明 (míng bright/tomorrow), 晴 (qíng sunny), 时 (shí time) — all contain 日 sun.

question: 月
answer: Moon / Month. Also means 'flesh/body' in many characters.
explanation: 脸 (liǎn face), 胳 (gē arm), 胸 (xiōng chest) — 月 here means flesh, not moon.

question: 心 / 忄
answer: Heart / Mind. 忄is the left-side form. Found in emotion and mental state characters.
explanation: 想 (xiǎng think/want), 忙 (máng busy), 怕 (pà afraid) — all contain heart radical.

question: 手 / 扌
answer: Hand. 扌is the left-side form. Found in action characters done with the hands.
explanation: 拿 (ná hold), 打 (dǎ hit/play), 拉 (lā pull) — all contain 扌hand radical.

question: 女
answer: Woman / Female. Found in characters related to women, family roles, and some adjectives.
explanation: 妈 (mā mom), 姐 (jiě older sister), 好 (hǎo good — woman + child = good).

question: 火 / 灬
answer: Fire. 灬is the bottom form (four dots). Found in cooking and heat-related characters.
explanation: 烧 (shāo burn/cook), 热 (rè hot), 煮 (zhǔ boil/cook) — all contain fire radical.

question: 土
answer: Earth / Soil / Ground. Found in characters related to land, places, construction.
explanation: 地 (dì ground/earth), 城 (chéng city), 堆 (duī pile/heap) — all contain 土 earth.

question: 言 / 讠
answer: Speech / Words. 讠is the simplified left-side form. Found in communication characters.
explanation: 说 (shuō speak), 请 (qǐng please/invite), 谢 (xiè thank) — all contain speech radical.

question: 金 / 钅
answer: Metal / Gold. 钅is the simplified left-side form. Found in metal objects and currency.
explanation: 钱 (qián money), 铁 (tiě iron), 银 (yín silver) — all contain 钅metal radical.

question: 山
answer: Mountain. Found in characters related to geography and landforms.
explanation: 岛 (dǎo island), 峰 (fēng peak), 岩 (yán rock/cliff) — all contain 山 mountain.

question: 目
answer: Eye. Found in characters related to seeing and visual perception.
explanation: 看 (kàn look/watch), 睡 (shuì sleep), 眼 (yǎn eye) — all contain 目 eye radical.
